card.name: Trailing zero in dose numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 (or a unit letter like b or U) that finishes a number right before a unit such as mg, in dose statements. Mostly seen in numbers like 20, 50, 150, 300, 80.

modes.label: Final zero of a dose
modes.description: The 0 ending a two- or three-digit dose number just before mg.
modes.example: Limit concomitant use of elagolix 15<<0>> mg once daily and ritonavir

modes.description: A unit letter completing a measure such as Gb/s or BAU/mL.
